description: Use this when a veteran's question needs VA regulations, legal standards or case law by keyword, citation or diagnostic code. It does not read a claim, predict a decision or give legal advice. Returns 38 CFR rating criteria, verbatim doctrine (pinpoints, capture and effective dates, reviewed holdings) and Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims (CAVC) excerpts (docket, case name, relevance); precedential CAVC decisions bind the Board of Veterans' Appeals; memorandum decisions do not. citation is a section ("3.310", "38 U.S.C. 5107(b)"); unreadable ones match nothing; query is optional when citation is supplied. limit: per-source results, default 5, maximum 10; doctrine caps at four with the true total. status: "ok" (all answered, each selected match carried), "partial" (a match missing, a component unfinished), "no_match" (all answered, none matched), "unavailable" (a component silent: nothing reads as absence of authority); statusReason says why. A truncation object (any status): doctrinePropositionsTrimmed counts entries serving only their first propositions (each with its true total); textBounded, a criterion withheld whole (row: criteriaOmitted, withheld length); resultsDropped, uncarried matches per regulatory, caseLaw and doctrine; responseTrimmedForSize, shed for size. Dockets and case names come only from results; it says if the case-law corpus is empty. citationResolved: true on positive evidence, false only after a full corpus scan, else null (open); citationStatus: resolved, unresolved, unknown, unparsed or not_supplied. coverage: citationScanComplete, candidateScansComplete, incompleteCandidateScans (components whose scan window filled before all candidates were examined), truncatedComponents, doctrineMatchedOn (doctrine from citation, query or standing authorities), searchComplete; with totalsAreMeasuredCounts false, a zero speaks for this search only.

citation.description: Exact citation to look up (e.g., "3.310", "38 CFR 3.310(b)", "4.16", "38 U.S.C. 5107(b)"). Sufficient on its own: a call with only a citation is answered as a citation lookup. A citation that cannot be read as a CFR or USC section matches nothing and is reported.

query.description: Search query (e.g., "PTSD secondary to MST", "DC 8100 migraine 50 percent criteria", "CUE in combined rating calculation"). Optional when citation is supplied; supply query, citation, or both.

name: search_legal_authority
title: Search case law and regulations
